answer: Random beacon checks catch fakes. You can't predict it, so you can't dodge it. Each epoch, a VRF beacon picks 5% at random. Picked? You've got 2 epochs to prove work. Miss it and your rewards freeze 6 epochs. Miss twice and you lose 50% of your stake. Don't park a thousand clones: an anchor of stake ties each down, and a dawn check can catch any. 1,000 clones lock 120,000 units, 50 get picked each round, so the timber gets chopped every epoch.
